name: What are common accessible features for kitchen design?

mainEntity.name: What are common accessible features for kitchen design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common accessible kitchen features include varied counter heights, allowing for both seated and standing use, and open space beneath sinks and cooktops for wheelchair clearance. Pull-out shelving, drawer dishwashers, and side-opening ovens improve access. Lever handles, touchless faucets, and rocker light switches enhance usability for those with limited hand dexterity. Good lighting and contrasting colors also contribute to a safer, more navigable space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common features include varied counter heights, roll-under sinks, pull-out shelving, and accessible appliances like side-opening ovens.
